mil7.2.3:1.1: ‘‘Bhante nāgasena, ‘kalandakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’nti yaṃ vadesi, katamaṃ taṃ ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabba’’nti?
mil7.2.3:1.2: ‘‘Yathā, mahārāja, kalandako paṭisattumhi opatante naṅguṭṭhaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā teneva naṅguṭṭhalaguḷena paṭisattuṃ paṭibāhati,
mil7.2.3:1.3: evameva kho, mahārāja, yoginā yogāvacarena kilesasattumhi opatante satipaṭṭhānalaguḷaṃ papphoṭetvā mahantaṃ katvā teneva satipaṭṭhānalaguḷena sabbakilesā paṭibāhitabbā.
mil7.2.3:1.4: Idaṃ, mahārāja, kalandakassa ekaṃ aṅgaṃ gahetabbaṃ.
